# Cncf Sops Reviewer

Review SOPS using its official documentation and repository in the Provisioning / Security &amp; Compliance category. sops is an editor of encrypted files that supports YAML, JSON, ENV, INI and BINARY formats and encrypts with AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, age, and PGP.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
